scripts.examples:install: for d in examples/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund) || exit 1; done
scripts.standalone: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/direct--standalone-app install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm --prefix examples/direct--standalone-app run dev
